Training eng: run-A COMPLETED successfully at min 100. Results due 110 (10-min buffer); maintenance at 119. No compute issues, no errors throughout. Handing off for result export/reporting.

Thanks to infra for the rescue export.

Training eng: Acknowledged. run-A trained clean to minute 100; results exported by infra at 119 (preserved before maintenance). Budget Controller: Acknowledged — compute budget held (1/1 extension, overrides per emergency authorization; no overspend).
